lessons.key: ac_gap::denylist scan tests must be discrimination tested in the same task the t4 literal guard initially scanned wrong relative paths and passed vacuously inject a violation and confirm the scan finds it before committing any file walking assertion
lessons.text: Denylist/scan tests must be discrimination-tested in the same task: the T4 literal guard initially scanned wrong relative paths and passed vacuously; inject a violation and confirm the scan finds it before committing any file-walking assertion.

lessons.key: spec_precision_gap::when an implementation value drifts from a recorded ad decision 5s 8s test shift update the ad record in the same commit that changes the value so the decision log never disagrees with the code
lessons.text: When an implementation value drifts from a recorded AD decision (5s -> 8s test shift), update the AD record in the same commit that changes the value so the decision log never disagrees with the code.

lessons.key: spec_precision_gap::when a spec ac requires displaying the server s rejection reason assert a value matcher on the reason text e g room not found not merely that some error text is visible
lessons.text: When a spec AC requires displaying the server's rejection reason, assert a value matcher on the reason text (e.g. /room not found/), not merely that some error text is visible.

lessons.key: spec_precision_gap::an ac listing multiple rejection causes needs one test path per cause need more players and round already active are separate scenarios not one
lessons.text: An AC listing multiple rejection causes needs one test path per cause - 'need more players' and 'round already active' are separate scenarios, not one.

lessons.key: gate_fail::the vite dev proxy must forward the colyseus room websocket path processid roomid sdk client buildendpoint not a fixed websocket the same origin gate 3 harness cannot catch dev proxy breakage verify pnpm boot manually when touching vite config or the connection layer
lessons.text: The vite dev proxy must forward the colyseus room websocket path /<processId>/<roomId> (SDK Client.buildEndpoint), not a fixed /websocket — the same-origin gate-3 harness cannot catch dev-proxy breakage; verify pnpm boot manually when touching vite.config or the connection layer.
